column1: # Pokémon Pokopia (Switch 2, update v327680 = 1.0.4). In bring-up
# Koei Tecmo's Motor / KTGL engine ("KTGL For Ounce"), SDK 20.5.25, NVN2 (Ampere shaders); modules main + subsdk0 (movie) + sdk.

# Packed from a dump folder (base/, updates/<version>/) with scripts/pack_dump.py. Shaders: GLSLC outputs in G2S containers in the IDRK entries of RDB .fdata files, as ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE's.
# The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's figure, not measured here). The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0).
# 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 9 GB heap region
# The rewritten modules take 82 MB, more than the default 64 MB of used memory, which SetHeapSize checks the request against
